_about: Numbers cited by the device-log-anomaly-detection kit. Every entry has class 'public' (a cited public paper, standard or documentation; real value) or 'illustrative' (a round number invented to explain an idea, of the same order of magnitude as real practice; never a measurement). No number here is copied from any internal source. Derived values say 'my arithmetic' in their source. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.

iforest_subsample_size_default.source: Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf §3 (psi = 256); scikit-learn IsolationForest documentation, https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.ensemble.IsolationForest.html (max_samples='auto' = min(256, n_samples))

iforest_trees_default.source: Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf §3 (t = 100); scikit-learn IsolationForest documentation, https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.ensemble.IsolationForest.html (n_estimators=100)

iforest_height_limit_psi256.source: ceil(log2 256); Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf §3; scikit-learn IsolationForest documentation, https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.ensemble.IsolationForest.html (max depth ceil(log2 n))

euler_mascheroni.source: Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf §2, approximation H(i) ~ ln(i) + 0.5772156649

iforest_c_256.source: my arithmetic from c(n) = 2H(n-1) - 2(n-1)/n in Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf Eq. 1

iforest_score_at_average_path.source: Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf §2: E(h(x)) -> c(n) gives s -> 0.5

iforest_score_3_splits_psi256.source: my arithmetic: 2^(-3/10.24), from Liu, Ting, Zhou, 'Isolation Forest', ICDM 2008, https://cs.nju.edu.cn/zhouzh/zhouzh.files/publication/icdm08b.pdf Eq. 2
